data.name: Perform Search (WikiSearch)
data.description:
Performs a faceted/full-text search using the WikiSearch extension and returns search results, aggregations and (optionally) debug information.
Documentation: https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:WikiSearch/api
Quick Start:
- Minimal required fields: action=query, format=json, meta=WikiSearch and a valid pageid referencing a page containing a WikiSearch configuration (created with #WikiSearchConfig).
- Example (cURL): POST form to {{baseUrl}}/api.php with action=query&format=json&meta=WikiSearch&pageid={{pageId}}&limit={{limit}}.
Parameters Explained:
- action (required): API action; use query. Default/example: query.
- format (required): Response format. Use json for machine-readable output. Default/example: json.
- meta (required): The meta module to call. For this extension use WikiSearch.
- pageid (required): Integer. The MediaWiki page ID of the page that contains the search configuration (created via #WikiSearchConfig). Must be a valid page ID containing a configuration. Example: 698.
- term (optional): string. Free-text search term. Defaults to empty string (returns all results when empty).
- from (optional): integer. Offset cursor for pagination. Defaults to 0.
- limit (optional): integer. Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.
- filter (optional): list (JSON-encoded). Filters to apply to the search. See Filters syntax section in the documentation for structure (PropertyRangeFilter, PropertyValueFilter, PropertyValuesFilter, HasPropertyFilter, PropertyTextFilter).
- aggregations (optional): list (JSON-encoded). Aggregations to compute (range, property etc.). See Aggregations syntax in doc.
- sorting (optional): list (JSON-encoded). Sorting objects (PropertySort, etc.).
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request / error key in response: Usually caused by malformed JSON in filter, aggregations or sorting parameters. Ensure those parameters are valid JSON and correctly URL-encoded or posted as form fields.
- 404 Not Found / empty results: If pageid does not reference a configuration page, you may get no results. Verify pageid is correct and that the page contains a WikiSearch configuration.
- Empty hits array: The query/filters returned no matching documents. Try removing filters or broadening term.
Edge Cases:
- The hits field in the response is a JSON-encoded string containing the raw ElasticSearch hits.hits structure — you must decode it (e.g., json_decode in PHP) to parse per-hit data and highlights.
- Highlight snippets (if present) are in each hit under the highlight hit-field; duplicates may be removed when generating highlight terms.
- Debug mode (if enabled on the server) will add a query object containing the raw ElasticSearch query used.
- aggregations range to values are exclusive; to include value 5, set to to 6 (documentation example).
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Rate limits and quotas are determined by the hosting wiki (this extension documentation does not define global API quotas). Check your MediaWiki instance / hosting provider for per-site limits.
data.evaluateGuide: Runs a configured WikiSearch full-text or faceted search through the MediaWiki Action API, returning results and aggregations.\nUse for: search configured wiki content, apply facets, inspect search aggregations\nNot supported: ordinary page search without configuration, editing pages, page creation

data.name: wbsearchentities (Wikibase: search entities)
data.description:
Overview:
Search for Wikibase entities by label, alias or description.
Documentation: wbsearchentities
Quick Start:
- GET {{baseUrl}}/w/api.php?action=wbsearchentities&search={{search}}&format=json
Parameters Explained:
- action: wbsearchentities.
- search (required): text to search for.
- language (optional): language code to search in.
- limit (optional): number of results (default/use documented defaults).
- format: json.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: missing search parameter.
Edge Cases:
- Search ranking may vary by language and alias data.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Limit parameter controls number of results; site may enforce max.
data.evaluateGuide: Searches Wikibase entities by label, alias, or description and returns matching entity results.\nUse for: find entities by name, search aliases, discover entity identifiers, search descriptions\nNot supported: entity editing, statement retrieval, page-text search

data.name: opensearch (OpenSearch search for the wiki)
data.description:
Search the wiki using the OpenSearch protocol (useful for quick suggestions/autocomplete).
Documentation: https://www.wikidata.org/w/api.php
Quick Start:
- GET action=opensearch&search=searchTerm&format=json&limit=10
Parameters Explained:
- search (required): Query string.
- limit (optional): Max results to return.
- namespace (optional): Namespace to search in.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: Missing search parameter.
Edge Cases:
- Responses are simple arrays for compatibility with OpenSearch consumers.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Rate-limited for heavy usage.
data.evaluateGuide: Uses the OpenSearch protocol to provide quick suggestions and autocomplete-style results from the wiki.\nUse for: autocomplete terms, suggest page titles, find quick matches\nNot supported: detailed entity search, full article retrieval, entity editing

data.name: Search Documents
data.description:
Performs a search query against the SearchLy index and returns ranked results.
Documentation: https://searchly.pro/documentation/
Quick Start:
- Set {{baseUrl}} = https://app.searchly.pro
- Provide your API key in the X-API-Key header ({{apiKey}})
- POST a JSON body containing at minimum query.
Parameters Explained:
- query (required, string): Text to search for (e.g. "laptop").
- top_k (optional, integer): Number of top results to return. Default: 10.
- filters (optional, object): Field filters to narrow results. Example: { "post_type": "product" }.
- algorithm (optional, string): Search algorithm. Valid values: default, fuzzy, exact. Default: default.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 401 Unauthorized: Missing or invalid X-API-Key header. Ensure X-API-Key: {{apiKey}} is set.
- 400 Bad Request: Malformed JSON body or missing query. Validate JSON and include query.
- 429 Too Many Requests: Rate limit exceeded. Back off and retry after a short delay.
- 500 Internal Server Error: Server-side issue — retry later and contact support if persistent.
Edge Cases:
- Very short queries (1-2 characters) may return many low-quality results or be filtered.
- Filters that reference non-indexed fields will return no results.
- When GPT correction is enabled and the initial search returns few/no results, the service may call the GPT correction endpoint internally (additional credit usage may apply).
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- API key scoped per-account. Refer to your plan for request quotas and credit usage.
data.evaluateGuide: Runs a ranked search over a SearchLy index using full-text queries and optional field filters.\nUse for: search indexed documents, rank results, filter by fields, retrieve top matches\nNot supported: document indexing, document updates, source content management

data.name: Wikisearch - Search Wikipedia (v1)
data.description:
Searches Wikipedia for pages matching a provided text string and returns a ranked list of matching pages with optional enriched metadata (types, categories, abstract, images, LOD links, alternate labels).
Documentation: https://dandelion.eu/docs/api/datagraph/wikisearch/
Quick Start:
- Ensure you have a Dandelion API token (32-character hex) available from your profile.
- Call the endpoint using GET (or POST) and provide text (required) and token (required). Example minimal GET: GET {{baseUrl}}/datagraph/wikisearch/v1?text=Paris&lang=en&token={{apiToken}}.
Parameters Explained:
- text (required): The string to match against Wikipedia titles. Type: string. Example: tower of big ben.
- lang (required): Language code for the search. Default: en. Accepted values: de | en | es | fr | it | pt | ru.
- limit (optional): Maximum number of results returned. Type: integer. Default: 10. Accepted range: 1 .. 50.
- offset (optional): Start index for results (for pagination). Type: integer. Default: 0.
- query (optional): Search mode. full finds all entities containing the text; prefix finds entities starting with the text (useful for autocomplete). Default: full.
- include (optional): Comma-separated list of additional fields to include for each entity: types, categories, abstract, image, lod, alternate_labels.
- Authentication: token (required) — a 32-character hexadecimal API token passed as a query parameter. Legacy app_id/app_key pair is supported (deprecated).
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request / error.missingParameter: Missing required parameter (e.g., text). Ensure text is provided.
- 401 Unauthorized / error.authenticationError: Invalid or missing token (or legacy app credentials). Provide a valid token via token={{apiToken}}.
- 429 Too Many Requests / error.RateLimitExceeded: You exceeded the rate limit (50 calls/sec per token). Back off and retry later.
- 413 Request Entity Too Large / error.requestTooLarge: Request body exceeds 1 MiB. Use GET/POST with smaller payloads or split requests.
Edge Cases:
- prefix query is optimized for autocomplete; it matches entries starting with the provided text.
- include=types returns DBpedia types extracted according to the lang parameter; different DBpedia instances may have different type sets.
- Images returned via include=image are hosted by Wikipedia — check licensing before using images in production.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Rate limit: 50 requests per second per token (or per legacy appid/appkey pair).
- Request size limit: 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes).
- Allowed methods: GET or POST.
data.evaluateGuide: Searches Wikipedia for matching pages and can return enriched metadata such as categories, abstracts, images, and links.\nUse for: find Wikipedia pages, retrieve abstracts, get categories, discover related links\nNot supported: editing articles, retrieving arbitrary web pages, semantic search across other sources

data.name: Search documents
data.description:
Performs hybrid search (full-text + semantic) against documents and returns paginated results.
Documentation: https://docs.intelliq.dev/api-reference/documents/search-documents
Quick Start:
- POST JSON to /api/v1/documents/search with the search query and optional language, page, and limit.
- Set Content-Type: application/json.
Parameters Explained:
- Body (application/json):
  - query (required): search string.
  - language (optional): language code or name to influence search (string).
  - page (optional): page number (default: 1).
  - limit (optional): results per page (default: 10).
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: missing query or invalid JSON body — ensure Content-Type: application/json and provide a valid query string.
Edge Cases:
- Results include pagination metadata similar to other listing endpoints.
- Semantic search relevance may vary depending on indexed embeddings and document processing status.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- No rate limits documented on this page.
data.evaluateGuide: Performs hybrid full-text and semantic search over indexed documents with pagination and optional language guidance.\nUse for: search documents, combine keyword and semantic matching, paginate results, filter by language\nNot supported: document upload, document modification, index administration

data.name: POST /{organization}/{project}/_apis/search/wikisearchresults
data.description:
Provides a set of wiki document search results for the given search text and filters.
Documentation: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/azure/devops/search/wiki-search-results/fetch-wiki-search-results?view=azure-devops-rest-7.1
Quick Start:
- Send a POST to https://almsearch.dev.azure.com/{organization}/{project}/_apis/search/wikisearchresults?api-version=7.1
- Include an OAuth2 access token authorized with the vso.wiki scope.
- Minimal request body: { "searchText": "", "$top": , "$skip": 0 }
Parameters Explained:
- URI parameters:
  - organization (required, path): The name of the Azure DevOps organization.
  - project (required, path): Project ID or project name.
  - api-version (required, query): API version to use — documented examples use 7.1.
- Request body:
  - $orderBy (optional, array of Sort Option): Sorting options; default is relevance.
  - $skip (optional, integer): Number of results to skip.
  - $top (optional, integer): Number of results to return.
  - filters (optional, object): Filters to be applied. Example: Project array.
  - includeFacets (optional, boolean): Return facets when true. Default false.
  - searchText (string): The search text.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- The response includes an infoCode integer with documented meanings (check infoCode on response):
  - 0: Ok
  - 1: Account is being reindexed
  - 2: Account indexing has not started
  - 3: Invalid Request
  - 4: Prefix wildcard query not supported
  - 5: MultiWords with code facet not supported
  - 6: Account is being onboarded
  - 7: Account is being onboarded or reindexed
  - 8: Top value trimmed to maxresult allowed
  - 9: Branches are being indexed
  - 10: Faceting not enabled
  - 11: Work items not accessible
  - 19: Phrase queries with code type filters not supported
  - 20: Wildcard queries with code type filters not supported
Edge Cases:
- Results include hits with fieldReferenceName and highlights illustrating matched snippets.
- includeFacets returns a facets object when enabled.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Not documented on the endpoint page; none provided in the referenced documentation.
data.evaluateGuide: Searches Azure DevOps wiki documents using supplied text and filters, returning matching wiki results.\nUse for: find wiki pages, filter wiki search, paginate matches, search project documentation\nNot supported: wiki editing, repository code search, work-item search
